## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector participation (9/11) supports market resiliency while narrow leadership (Top 5: 3/5 Energy) and notable megacap divergences suppress a clean risk-on read.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.09% | 1M: +19.12%), PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.84% | 1M: +15.47%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +9.76%). Technology strong on momentum: INTU ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +28.10%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +0.47%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Staples weak: MO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.71%), MNST BELOW TREND (1W: -50.58% | 1M: -52.37%). Consumer Discretionary under pressure with TJX in CORRECTION (1W: -4.79% | 1M: +2.20%) and RCL in CORRECTION (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +6.06%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.09% | 1M: +19.12%), PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.84% | 1M: +15.47%), PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +33.83%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.18% | 1M: +17.63%), INTU ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +28.10%). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy) — caution on concentration.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: HON in CORRECTION (1W: -2.80% | 1M: +5.00%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -6.62%), RCL in CORRECTION (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +6.06%), ROST in CORRECTION (1W: -3.68% | 1M: +8.48%), GE in CORRECTION (1W: -3.71% | 1M: +0.08%). Weakness concentrated in select industrials and large-cap tech.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: MPC (1W: +19.09% | 1M: +19.12%), PSX (1W: +14.84% | 1M: +15.47%), PLTR (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +33.83%), VLO (1W: +13.18% | 1M: +17.63%), INTU (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +28.10%). Major divergence flagged: multiple megacaps (MSFT CORRECTION, AMZN CORRECTION, V CORRECTION) have 1W vs 1M mismatches — watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but positive momentum. NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +6.02%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.89% | 1M: +17.91%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -6.71%). Sector breadth: approx. 18/24 positive — internal rotation between AI winners and lagging megacaps.

8. Financials Outlook?
Steady and constructive. JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +4.67%), V in CORRECTION (1W: -1.17% | 1M: +3.09%), AIG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -0.98%). Sector breadth: approx. 12/20 positive — cautious participation, not broad excess.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive bid but mixed. JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.98% | 1M: +6.10%), PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +9.87%), UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -4.65%). Sector breadth: approx. 12/17 positive — news-driven pockets (PFE, LLY) leading.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Energy and select Tech winners while monitoring concentration risk; reduce exposure to the weakest Consumer Staples and isolated laggard megacaps. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — tactical exposure to cyclical energy names, selective on tech momentum.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.09% | 1M: +19.12%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +0.47%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.89% | 1M: +17.91%). BEARISH: GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -6.62%), MNST BELOW TREND (1W: -50.58% | 1M: -52.37%), MO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.71%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth: ~9/10 positive) on strong flows and earnings/guide beats. BEARISH: Consumer Staples (Breadth: ~3/14 positive) and Consumer Discretionary showing early weakness and headline risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
MPC breakout continuation to watch (1W: +19.09% | 1M: +19.12%) for further energy rotation; NVDA 1W gains (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +6.02%) to confirm tech leadership; GOOGL below-trend (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -6.62%) — watch for failure to reclaim 1M trend.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LRCX (+60): Lam Research expansion headline — LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +0.47%) — price confirms sentiment. ORCL (+55): AWS partnership expansion — ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.89% | 1M: +17.91%) — sentiment confirmed. PFE (+65): higher guidance and trial data — PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +9.87%) — confirming accumulation. GE (+75): industrial earnings lift but GE in CORRECTION (1W: -3.71% | 1M: +0.08%) — news/price divergence, watch follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
HON (-45): management guidance disappointment — HON in CORRECTION (1W: -2.80% | 1M: +5.00%) — sentiment aligns with short-term weakness. CAT (-40): margin concerns highlighted — CAT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.28% | 1M: -6.36%) — sentiment confirmed and risk to industrials.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. MPC, ORCL and NVDA showing relative strength (MPC ABOVE TREND, ORCL ABOVE TREND, NVDA ABOVE TREND). Key risk: narrow leadership (Top 5: 3/5 Energy) and major megacap divergences (MSFT, AMZN, V in CORRECTION) — watch for trend breaks and sentiment/price divergences (e.g., GE).
